### VF-045: a second Codex session opened the run-brief skill before working alone

### Record that a runner in the agent's workspace killed the watcher's runs of six jobs (VF-051)

change `pvukkvwsxwzm` · [log `4be1ccb1f7e4`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/01a1f5be-43bd-7532-a80c-5b4f5c304590/4be1ccb1f7e467efb0a82424324073f97b802ac159ddf21a7fa80c5e1c35899d.jsonl.gz)

The external-upgrade-evaluation agent ran pipeline.py run in its own workspace while the watcher's runner had its six new Maven jobs running.
